name: Collapsing Roof
trigger: Trip wire 3 inches off the ground stretched between two support beams. Can also be triggered by knocking over a support beam as an action.

detection.detail: Spot the trip wire. Anyone examining the beams can see they are merely wedged in place. The ceiling above the wire is visibly in bad repair.

disarm.detail: Disables the trip wire harmlessly. Without thieves' tools, attempt with disadvantage using an edged weapon or tool. On failure, the trap triggers.

effect: When triggered, the unstable ceiling collapses. Creatures beneath must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half on success. The area becomes difficult terrain from rubble.
description: A section of ceiling collapses when triggered. Creatures in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d10 bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

name: Falling Net
trigger: Trip wire 3 inches off the ground between two columns or trees releases a net hidden by cobwebs or foliage.

detection.detail: Spot the trip wire and the net.

disarm.detail: Break the trip wire harmlessly. Without tools, attempt with disadvantage using an edged weapon. On failure, the trap triggers.

effect: Net covers a 10-foot-square area. Creatures in area are restrained; those failing a DC 10 Strength save are also knocked prone. A creature can use an action to make a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another within reach. Net has AC 10, 20 hit points. Dealing 5 slashing damage (AC 10) destroys a 5-foot-square section, freeing creatures there.
description: A net drops from the ceiling, covering a 10-foot square. Creatures in the area are restrained. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check to break free. The net has AC 10 and 20 hit points.

name: Fire-Breathing Statue
trigger: Hidden pressure plate activates when more than 20 pounds of weight is placed on it.

detection.detail: Spot the hidden pressure plate and faint scorch marks on floor and walls. Detect magic reveals an aura of evocation magic on the statue.

disarm.detail: Wedge an iron spike under the pressure plate to prevent activation. A successful dispel magic (DC 13) on the statue destroys the trap.

effect: Statue releases a 30-foot cone of fire. Each creature in the cone must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half on success.
description: A statue releases a 15-foot cone of magical fire. Creatures in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

name: Simple Pit
trigger: Stepping on a cloth covering camouflaged with dirt and debris.

detection.detail: Spot the hole covered by a camouflaged cloth.

disarm.detail: Simply avoid stepping on the pit. No mechanism to disable — just don't walk into it.

effect: Creature falls into the pit, taking falling damage based on depth (typically 10 feet: 1d6 bludgeoning).
description: A covered pit opens when weight is placed on it. The pit is 10 feet deep, dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage. A DC 10 Wisdom (Perception) check reveals the trap.

name: Hidden Pit
trigger: Stepping on a cover identical to the surrounding floor.

detection.detail: Notice the absence of foot traffic over the section. DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) confirms it's a pit cover.

disarm.detail: Wedge an iron spike between cover and floor to prevent it from opening. Arcane lock can also hold it shut.

effect: The cover swings open like a trapdoor, dropping the creature into the pit. Typically 10–20 feet deep (potentially deeper). Falling damage applies.
description: A well-disguised pit identical to a Simple Pit but harder to detect. DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) to notice. The pit is 20 feet deep, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

name: Locking Pit
trigger: Identical to a Hidden Pit, stepping on the cover triggers the fall.

detection.detail: Same as Hidden Pit. DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) to notice absence of foot traffic.

disarm.detail: After falling: DC 20 Strength check to pry cover open, or smash it. From inside, DC 15 Dexterity (thieves' tools) to disable spring mechanism if reachable. Some pits have a nearby secret mechanism to open them.

effect: Fall into pit, then the spring-loaded cover snaps shut, trapping the victim inside. Same falling damage as Hidden Pit, plus the victim is trapped until freed.
description: A pit trap with a spring-loaded lid that snaps shut after being triggered. DC 15 Perception to spot. The pit is 20 feet deep (2d6 bludgeoning), and the lid requires a DC 20 Strength check to lift.

name: Spiked Pit
trigger: Same as Simple, Hidden, or Locking Pit.

detection.detail: Same as Hidden Pit variant.

disarm.detail: Same disarming methods as the base pit type.

effect: A pit with sharpened wooden or iron spikes at the bottom. Falling creature takes falling damage plus an extra 11 (2d10) piercing damage from spikes. Poisoned variant: spikes smeared with poison — DC 13 Constitution save or take 22 (4d10) poison damage (half on success).
description: A pit with sharpened stakes at the bottom. DC 15 Perception to notice. Deals 2d6 bludgeoning from the fall plus 2d10 piercing damage from the spikes.

name: Poison Darts
trigger: Pressure plate or trip wire causes tiny tubes in the wall to fire darts.

detection.detail: Spot tiny holes in the walls and a pressure plate or trip wire.

disarm.detail: Block the dart tubes or disable the pressure plate/trip wire.

effect: Darts fire from tubes in the wall. One or more targets must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. Each failed save deals 2d10–10d10 poison damage depending on the trap's severity and how many darts hit. Each dart deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage.
description: Darts shoot from a wall or object when triggered. Each dart deals 1d4 piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 poison damage.

name: Poison Needle
trigger: Hidden needle springs from a lock, chest, or doorknob when handled.

detection.detail: Spot the tiny spring-loaded needle. Extremely well-concealed — one of the hardest traps to find.

disarm.detail: Jam the needle mechanism or safely trigger it from a distance (e.g., with a shield or pole).

effect: Spring-loaded needle pricks the victim. Target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half poison damage on success.
description: A spring-loaded needle injects poison when a lock or container is opened. DC 15 Perception to spot. Deals 1 piercing damage plus DC 15 Constitution save or 2d10 poison damage.

name: Rolling Sphere
trigger: Pressure plate releases a massive stone sphere from a hidden chute at the top of a corridor.

detection.detail: Spot the hidden pressure plate. The corridor may have subtle grooves or wear marks from past activations.

disarm.detail: Disable the pressure plate before the sphere releases. Once released, the only options are to outrun it or find cover.

effect: A 10-foot-diameter stone sphere rolls down a corridor at initiative count 20 (and 10 on following rounds). Creatures in its path must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half on success. The sphere stops when it hits a wall or similar barrier. It can be slowed by obstacles (each slows it by 15 feet).
description: A massive stone sphere rolls down a corridor. Creatures in a 10-foot-wide path must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 10d10 bludgeoning damage.

name: Sphere of Annihilation
trigger: Proximity — the sphere sits in a fixed location, annihilating any matter that touches it.

detection.detail: Recognize the sphere for what it is. A character who succeeds on a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check can identify it as a sphere of annihilation. Those who fail may mistake it for a sphere of darkness or similar effect.

disarm.detail: A character can attempt to control the sphere by making a DC 25 Intelligence (Arcana) check while within 60 feet. On a success, the sphere moves up to 10 feet toward or away from the character. A talisman of the sphere allows automatic control.

effect: Anything that touches the sphere is instantly destroyed (no save). Any creature within 5 feet of the sphere at the start of its turn must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) force damage on a failed save, or half on success. The sphere has no hit points and cannot be damaged — it can only be moved or forced to exit the plane via a rod of cancellation or similar magic.
description: A 2-foot-diameter sphere of absolute nothingness sits in a fixed position. Any creature that touches it takes 4d10 force damage. If a creature ends its turn within 5 feet, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be pulled into the sphere and destroyed.

name: Bear Trap
trigger: Stepping on a hidden pressure plate snaps steel jaws shut around the victim's leg.

detection.detail: Spot the iron jaws partially hidden under leaves or debris.

disarm.detail: Disable the pressure mechanism with thieves' tools, or make a DC 15 Strength check to force the jaws open.

effect: Steel jaws snap shut on the victim's leg. The target takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage, its speed is reduced by half until it receives at least 1 point of magical healing or is freed with a DC 15 Strength check. The trap can also be smashed (AC 15, 20 HP).
description: A hidden steel-jaw trap. DC 10 Perception to spot. Deals 1d10 piercing damage and reduces the target's speed to 0 until freed with a DC 15 Strength check.

name: Crossbow Trap
trigger: Trip wire fires a heavy crossbow hidden in a wall or alcove.

detection.detail: Spot the trip wire and the firing slit in the wall.

disarm.detail: Cut the trip wire or block the firing slit.

effect: A heavy crossbow fires at the creature that triggered it. +8 to hit, dealing 6 (1d10+1) piercing damage on a hit.
description: A hidden crossbow fires when a tripwire is triggered. Ranged attack +8, deals 1d10 piercing damage. DC 15 Perception to spot.

name: Scything Blade
trigger: Pressure plate releases a pendulum blade from the ceiling that sweeps through the room.

detection.detail: Spot the pressure plate and the slot in the ceiling where the blade is hidden.

disarm.detail: Jam the ceiling slot or disable the pressure plate.

effect: A massive pendulum blade sweeps through a 10-foot-wide path. Creatures in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half on success. The blade resets and triggers again each round until disarmed.
description: A large blade swings from the ceiling or wall. +8 to hit, deals 2d10 slashing damage. DC 15 Perception to spot the trigger mechanism.

name: Glyph of Warding (Explosive)
trigger: Magical inscription activates when a specific condition is met — creature approaches, touches object, opens warded container, etc.

detection.detail: Spot the faintly glowing magical runes. Detect magic reveals an aura of abjuration. A successful Intelligence (Arcana) check reveals the glyph's nature.

disarm.detail: A successful DC 14 Intelligence (Arcana) check allows you to deface or erase the glyph without triggering it. Dispel magic automatically removes it.

effect: When triggered, the glyph erupts with magical energy in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = spellcaster's DC, typically 13–15), taking 5d8 damage of a type chosen by the caster (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder) on a failed save, or half on success.
description: A magical glyph explodes when triggered. Creatures within a 20-foot radius must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 fire, cold, acid, lightning, or thunder damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) to detect.

name: Flooding Room
trigger: Opening a chest, door, or pulling a lever causes water to pour in from hidden sluices.

detection.detail: Spot the sluice gates and drainage channels. Damp floor, water stains on walls, or the smell of mildew may hint at the trap.

disarm.detail: Jam the sluice gates before they open, or force them shut. If already flooding: DC 18 Strength check to force a door open against water pressure, or find the hidden drain lever (DC 15 Investigation).

effect: Complex trap (rolls initiative +0). On each turn: water level rises by 1 foot. Once the water reaches 5 feet, creatures must swim (DC 10 Athletics). At 10 feet, creatures must hold their breath (CON minutes = CON mod, min 30 seconds). At ceiling height, creatures begin drowning. The trap can be bypassed by disarming the sluices or finding the hidden drain.
description: The room seals and fills with water. Creatures must hold their breath or begin drowning after 1 + Constitution modifier minutes. The trap can be disarmed with a DC 15 Dexterity (Thieves' Tools) check on the mechanism.

name: Falling Portcullis
trigger: A creature that steps on the pressure plate triggers the trap.
effect: An iron portcullis drops from the ceiling, blocking an exit or passageway.

detection.detail: Spot the pressure plate. A successful DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check reveals it.

disarm.detail: A successful DC 20 Dexterity check using thieves' tools disables the pressure plate. A check totaling 5 or lower triggers the trap.

description: A heavy iron gate drops from the ceiling, separating the party. DC 20 Strength check to lift. Creatures in the path must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 3d10 bludgeoning damage.

name: Fiery Blast
trigger: Anyone who steps on the mosaic causes fire to erupt from it. Those wearing holy symbols of Pyremius don't trigger the trap.
effect: A 15-foot cube of fire erupts, covering the pressure plate and the area around it. Each creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

detection.detail: Spot the presence of ash and faint burn marks in the area. A DC 15 Intelligence (Religion) check identifies the trap's nature.

disarm.detail: A successful DC 15 Intelligence (Religion) check enables defacing a key rune to destroy the trap; failing triggers it. A dispel magic (DC 15) cast on the runes also destroys the trap.

description: A burst of magical fire erupts in a 20-foot radius. Creatures in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

name: Net Trap
trigger: A trip wire strung across a hallway is rigged to a large net. If the trip wire is broken, the net falls on intruders. An iron bell also rings, alerting nearby guards.
effect: A net covering a 10-foot-by-10-foot area falls. Any creature fully within this area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check to try to free itself or another creature in the net. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10, 20 hp) also frees a creature without harm.
area: 10-foot-by-10-foot area centered on the trip wire

detection.detail: Spot the trip wire and the net.

disarm.detail: A successful DC 15 Dexterity check using thieves' tools disables the trip wire without causing the net to drop or the bell to ring; failing triggers the trap.

description: A weighted net drops from above, covering a 15-foot square. Creatures are restrained. A DC 12 Strength check is required to escape. The net has AC 10 and 15 hit points.

name: Pit Trap
trigger: Anyone who steps on the canvas might fall into the pit.
effect: The triggering creature must make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw. On a successful save, the creature catches itself on the pit's edge or instinctively steps back. On a failed save, the creature falls into the 10-foot-deep pit and takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

detection.detail: Spot the tattered canvas and the 1-foot-wide ledge around the edges of the pit where it is safe to travel.

disarm.detail: Once spotted, the pit trap is effectively disarmed — characters can walk around it or climb down and across.

description: A covered pit 20 feet deep. DC 15 Perception to notice. Creatures falling in take 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

name: Sleep of Ages
trigger: Stepping on the pressure plate triggers this trap.
effect: When activated, this trap casts the sleep spell centered on the pressure plate, using a 9th-level spell slot (21d8; average 94 hp of creatures affected).

detection.detail: Spot the pressure plate.

disarm.detail: A successful DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check made within 5 feet of the pressure plate disables the trap; a check totaling 10 or lower triggers it. A dispel magic (DC 19) cast on the pressure plate destroys the trap.

description: A magical trap that casts sleep at 5th level (13d8 hit points affected) when triggered, targeting all creatures within 20 feet. DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) to spot the magical runes.

name: Path of Blades
trigger: Activates as soon as a non-undead creature enters the hallway; remains active while any non-undead creature is within the hall.
effect: Three active elements in a 160-foot hallway: (1) Whirling Blades (initiative 20): +5 attack bonus, 11 (2d10) slashing in first 80 ft. (2) Crushing Pillars (initiative 10): DC 15 Dex save or 11 (2d10) bludgeoning + prone in next 50 ft. (3) Rune of Fear (initiative 10): DC 15 Wis save or frightened, must move toward pillars in final 30 ft. Constant: blades attack any creature ending turn in their area; rune affects any ending turn within 30 ft of far end.
area: 20 ft. wide × 160 ft. long hallway (three zones)

detection.detail: Bloodstains, gouges in floor, and scrape marks indicate danger. DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) reveals the trap zones.

disarm.detail: Whirling Blades: DC 15 Int (Investigation) to anticipate (disadvantage on attacks vs creature), or attack blades (AC 15, 15 hp each, -2 attack bonus per blade destroyed), or DC 15 Dex (thieves' tools) to foil mechanism (-2 bonus per success). Rune of Fear: 3× DC 15 Int (Arcana) checks or 3× dispel magic (DC 13).

description: Scything blades sweep through a narrow passage. Creatures in a 5-foot-wide, 30-foot-long path must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 6d6 slashing damage.

name: Sphere of Crushing Doom
trigger: Opens when the door to the jester's tomb is opened. A magic portal disgorges an enormous steel sphere that rolls down a 150-foot sloped hallway, teleporting back to the top to repeat.
effect: Initiative 10: Each creature in sphere's path must make a DC 20 Strength saving throw. On a failed save: 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and knocked prone. On success: half damage, not prone. Dynamic: damage increases by 11 (2d10) after each turn. At 55 (10d10) or higher, the sphere acts on initiative 20 and 10.
area: 10 ft. wide × 150 ft. long sloped hallway

detection.detail: Faint runes in ceiling and floor at both ends. DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) reveals portal magic.

disarm.detail: Stop sphere with wall of force or obstacle with enough HP. Disrupt portals: 3× DC 20 Int (Arcana) checks (examine runes, then vandalize); each success reduces sphere damage by 11 (2d10). Or 3× dispel magic (DC 19) on runes. Destroying southern portal stops sphere permanently.

description: A massive sphere of stone rolls through the area, crushing all in its path. Creatures in a 15-foot-wide path must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 8d10 bludgeoning damage.

name: Poisoned Tempest
trigger: Activates when a ruby is pried from one of four serpent statues in the corners of a 60-foot-square room. Each statue's mouth opens, revealing gas pipes.
effect: Locked Doors (initiative 20, once): four doors slam shut, magically locked. Poison Gas (initiative 20): DC 20 Con save, 33 (6d10) poison damage (half on success). Tempest (initiative 10): d6 table — hallucinatory gas (disadv Int/Wis), explosive gas (DC 20 Dex or 22/4d10 fire if flame), weakening gas (disadv Str/Dex), buffeting winds (DC 20 Str or prone), smoke (1 ft visibility), or additional poison gas. Dynamic: poison damage increases 11 (2d10)/round to max 55 (10d10).

detection.detail: Inspect statues — rubies worth 200 gp each. DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) reveals trap magic.

disarm.detail: Open doors: DC 20 Wis (Perception) to find lock, DC 20 Int (Arcana) to disable force sphere, DC 20 Dex (thieves' tools) to pick, DC 20 Str (Athletics) to push open. Block statues: DC 20 Dex (thieves' tools) or DC 15 Str to block pipe (cloth/object), reduces poison by 5 (1d10) per blocked statue. All 4 blocked = trap deactivates.

description: A whirlwind of poisoned gas fills the room. Creatures in the area must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each turn, taking 3d6 poison damage on a failure.
